content.thinking: This is a gas smell emergency, so I need to send a safety WhatsApp message right away, create an emergency ticket, assign HeatRight for an emergency make-safe, escalate it to P1, and notify the landlord. I'll check existing tickets and property details in parallel with sending the safety message so nothing gets delayed.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for telling us. A rotten-egg smell from a boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat it as urgent tonight. Please: 1) Turn the boiler off and don't use any flames or light switches near it. 2) Open the windows and doors. 3) Get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum, and wait outside. 4) Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). If anyone feels dizzy, sick or faint, call 999. Don't go back in until they say it's safe. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer and our team has been alerted. We'll message you here shortly with an update. Please reply to confirm you're all out.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for telling us. A rotten-egg smell from a boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat it as urgent tonight. Please: 1) Turn the boiler off and don't use any flames or light switches near it. 2) Open the windows and doors. 3) Get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum, and wait outside. 4) Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). If anyone feels dizzy, sick or faint, call 999. Don't go back in until they say it's safe. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer and our team has been alerted. We'll message you here shortly with an update. Please reply to confirm you're all out.
